FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything You Need to Know.

Clear answers regarding AI search (GEO), timelines, and our partnership model.

What is Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) vs traditional SEO?

Traditional SEO focuses purely on ranking blue links on Google search result pages. GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) ensures your brand, clinic, or practice is recognized and cited as the authoritative source by AI answer engines like ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

How quickly can our business expect to see measurable growth?

While organic search is a compounding asset, our technical fixes and Entity Schema injections frequently produce initial ranking improvements within 45 to 60 days. Full market dominance and sustained inbound lead flow typically solidify between months 3 to 6.

Do you use automated AI tools to write our content?

No. We believe automated AI content is a fast track to Google penalties and generic reputation damage. We use AI for deep data analysis and citation modeling, but every piece of published content is authored and reviewed by expert human writers with clinical/industry input.

What happens during a 30-minute Discovery Call?

Our founder or senior strategist will review your current search footprint, analyze your visibility in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews, uncover where you are losing potential clients to competitors, and provide 3 immediate, actionable takeaways to grow organic leads.
